Review Text:
About 14 years ago I was in the area and could enjoy just a glimpse of Canyonlands, things you could only see from the road. But I imagined that there will be much more and the only way to grasp that was by airplane. Back then I planned to make it happen, should I be in the area again. Due to the pandemic it took a bit longer...
Feed forward to the present, and today was the day! I originally planned to take the combo flight of both parks, but it seemed that the minimum number of participants dit not materialize, so I had to fall back on the Canyonlands alone. No regret, we were four passengers and I could take the place beside the pilot and was very impressed by the various landscapes, canyons, arches under the plane. The pilot was very well informed about the various stone types told us a lot of things, including where there were film sets of famous movies.

Review Text: We had the most amazing experience, from start to finish, with Redtail Air Adventures! I had originally scheduled a helicopter tour for the morning of my birthday, however due to the flight schedule, they called to let me know that the helicopter needed routine maintenance & wouldn’t be available that day. I was so disappointed, but they quickly arranged for my husband and I to do a complimentary airplane tour instead. I was blown away by their generosity and kindness. We had spent the past 2 days hiking Canyonlands and Arches NP, and to see it then from the air was amazing. Views were unparalleled and our pilot was awesome! If we’re ever back in Moab, we will definitely be doing another tour. Book with Redtail, you won’t be disappointed. Thanks to the entire team at Redtail for kicking off my special day in the most amazing way!
